committed_events.content: 小姐果然警觉，没有贸然上前。她这是在拖延时间，也是在呼唤帮手。我必须立刻响应，不能给假千金任何单独接触药碗的机会。

committed_events.speaker: 男仆人
committed_events.content: 在走廊上听到真千金的声音，立刻快步走到卧室门口，微微躬身，声音平稳而清晰。

committed_events.speaker: 男仆人
committed_events.content: 大小姐，张妈正在厨房忙活，一时走不开。小的正好在附近，可以进来伺候。

beats.label: Opening Beat
beats.objective: Open the scene quickly and lock the premise into public view.
beats.must_land: 假千金装病博取同情，真千金被迫照顾反被诬陷下毒。
beats.exit_condition: The room clearly understands what the confrontation is about.

beats.label: Pressure Beat
beats.objective: Escalate the main conflict instead of repeating surface emotion.
beats.must_land: 假千金声称因“被污蔑”而心病加重，要求真千金端药伺候，却暗中在药里加料，诬陷真千金下毒害她。
beats.exit_condition: At least one side loses room to keep stalling.

beats.label: Reversal Beat
beats.objective: Force a shift in power, information, or emotional control.
beats.must_land: A new piece of leverage, confession, or reversal must enter the scene.
beats.exit_condition: The scene no longer feels balanced.

beats.label: Hook Beat
beats.objective: Land the episode hook and steer toward a clean cut point.
beats.must_land: 众人闻讯赶来，假千金虚弱地指着真千金和药碗。男仆人却突然开口：“老爷，这碗药，在端进来之前，我检查过。”
beats.exit_condition: The hook is explicit enough that the next episode has momentum.
